sentences.text: No, Clause 9.3 does not comply with the current RBI rules for this case because a Tier 3 UCB with a floating-rate loan to an individual for non_business is covered by the rule that prepayment charge is not permitted.
The Home Loan Agreement states that on foreclosure or pre-payment, in full or in part, the Borrower shall pay a pre-payment charge of 2% of the principal outstanding.
The same agreement table also states pre-payment charge as 2% of principal outstanding on pre-payment or foreclosure.
The documents do not state any current exception that allows this 2% charge for this case.

missing.searched: R3, R4 and the in-force loan agreement clauses E2, E3
